items.title: Business Permit (new and renewal)
items.summary: Every business operating in Batangas City needs a Mayor's/Business Permit before it starts operating.
items.office: Business Permits & Licensing Office (BPLO), under the City Mayor's Office
details: Renew every January 1-31. The City Treasurer imposes penalties after the period.
Simplified steps: (1) Filing and assessment - no application form is required anymore; (2) Pay at the cashier and claim the permit.
Barangay clearance is now integrated into the business permitting process under the Ease of Doing Business Act.
requirements: New: Occupancy Permit from the City Engineer's Office
All businesses: City Environment Permit to Operate (CEPO) from CENRO
Renewal: Barangay/Market Clearance and Income Tax Return
Authorization letter if a representative applies
items.fees: Business tax and other fees depend on capitalization, per the Batangas City Revenue Code of 2009.

items.title: Environment Requests (tree cutting or pruning, hauling clearance)

details: Also handles the authorization to haul, tipping-fee order of payment, and endorsement letters to DENR for tree cutting.

items.title: Tricycle and Public Utility Vehicle Permits
items.summary: Mayor's Permit for motorized tricycles, jeepneys (PUJ body number) and buses.
details: Tricycles need an inspection slip before the Mayor's Permit is issued.

items.title: Prosecutor's Clearance
items.summary: Clearance issued by the City Prosecutor's Office.
items.office: Office of the City Prosecutor, Hall of Justice, Pallocan West
items.fees: NPS legal fee depends on the purpose of the clearance (the charter lists examples such as PhP 300 for business permit and PhP 500 for permit to carry firearms). Confirm current fees with the office.
details: Pay the legal fee, wait for the drafted clearance, validate it, then claim it with the dry seal.

items.title: Senior Citizen ID
items.summary: IDs for senior citizens, distributed in barangays so seniors do not have to travel to the office.
items.office: Office of the Senior Citizens Affairs (OSCA)
details: As of 2024 reports, around 44,000 senior citizens were covered by the new ID distribution.

items.title: EBD Health Card Program
items.summary: Helps poor residents access free hospitalization.
details: Described on the city website as a leading LGU program for free hospitalization of the poor.

items.title: EBD Scholarship

details: Ask the Mayor's Action Center about current slots and requirements. A referral letter (see Services) may be needed.

items.title: Yellow Corn Sufficiency Program
items.summary: Farmers receive subsidized corn seeds and free use of tractors, corn dryers and corn shredders.

items.title: Sagip Kalinga sa mga Bata
items.summary: Program that helps and protects children from risks and abuse.

items.title: Social Pension for Indigent Senior Citizens
items.summary: DSWD monthly stipend for indigent seniors, implemented with the local government.
details: National program: PhP 500 monthly per 2022 reports. Confirm the current amount with OSCA.

items.title: Centenarian Cash Benefits
items.summary: City cash gifts to residents aged 100 and above.
details: Amounts reported in news: PhP 20,000 and PhP 5,000 depending on category. Confirm with OSCA.

items.title: Public Employment Services (PESO)
items.summary: Job matching and employment assistance.

items.title: Disaster Preparedness Trainings and Drills
items.summary: CDRRMO trains barangays, schools and businesses in rescue, first aid and emergency response, including earthquake and flood drills.

items.title: Batangas City Revenue Code of 2009
items.summary: Sets business registration, Mayor's Permit requirements, permit fees and renewal periods.
details: Business permit renewal: January 1-31 each year, with penalties after.
Chapter VI covers permit fees.

items.title: Citizen's Charter

details: Available online on the city website under Citizen's Charter.

items.title: Ease of Doing Business integration
items.summary: Barangay clearance is part of the business permit process, and new applicants are covered by the city's One-Stop-Shop for Construction Permit (OSCP).

items.title: Resolutions and Ordinances
